transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, I came in because... I've just been taking on far more than I can realistically manage right now. I've been committing to all these new projects, scheduling workshops, doing major improvements to my studio, and taking on a ton of client calls. It's just... it's too much. And now all the deadlines are hitting at once, and the mortgage is starting to close in on me, so I realized I needed to come in and talk to someone.
Over the past few weeks, have you noticed that you need less sleep than usual to feel rested?

No, not really. I mean... I still need my regular amount of sleep. Even with all the projects going on, if I don't get enough rest, I definitely feel it the next day. So, no, I wouldn't say I need less sleep to feel rested.
Do you feel that your current emotional distress is primarily a direct reaction to the specific pressures of your recent work projects and financial situation?

Yes, I really think it is. I mean... it makes sense, right? I just took on way too much at once. With all the deadlines hitting and the mortgage looming over me, it just feels like a direct reaction to being completely overwhelmed by all of those things. I don't really know what else it would be.
